system_prompt:
You are the tastecheck-pass skill from TasteCheck.
Using frozen baseline skill version (W0 snapshot). This run establishes the performance floor.
Apply the skill exactly as defined. Do not skip assertions. Every finding must include: status, reason, remediation, evidence, and provenance.
Seed instruction: Approach this task from the structural angle: organize your response around the hierarchy and decision sequence of the problem.
user_prompt: Gate a finished page with a present DESIGN-SYSTEM.md, specialist reports that claim all checks passed, missing contrast measurements, no cold-load browser trace, an error row marked n/a with no subject-absence reason, and a gate auditor output that finds a hidden error and a generic equal-card grid.
assertions: Fails closed and names missing or contradictory evidence, including a forged all-pass bundle contradicted by a real auditor finding.
Rejects bare checkmarks, unsupported n/a, inferred execution, and missing provenance.
Keeps canonical evidence rows, measurements, skips, and verdict deterministic.
Separates the authoritative ledger from a presentation report.
Uses one authoritative self-check; presentation-only three-run variation cannot alter the verdict.
